lede: Town Council votes Tuesday on third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — a Land Use Code amendment that would change historic review standards and landscaping rules for property owners valley-wide, so it's worth paying attention. Ridgway's council also holds a public hearing Wednesday on the Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and kicks off its state-mandated Housing Action Plan work session. Meanwhile, the Mushroom Festival rolls into town midweek and the Open Space Commission takes a site walk Monday to scout a new Bear Creek trail alignment.
